run_exit_scenario: run a gRPC exit scenario test by passing a scenario name like running_server via CLI
test_GenericHandler: test the GenericHandler class that routes RPC methods to the correct hanging servicer handler
test_MethodHandler: test the MethodHandler class that assigns hang functions based on streaming and partial hang flags
test_DaemonPool: test the DaemonPool executor that submits tasks as daemon threads to avoid blocking exit
run_inflight_call_test: run an in-flight RPC call test scenario such as unary_unary or stream_stream via CLI
